name: phase2-replay-opt
description: Minimal overflow scenario: one compute node has a deliberately small local tier, so even a single KV cache exceeds local capacity and must use the shared pool. This verifies the remote path, eviction, and traffic accounting. It is not a hardware recommendation and must not be used for absolute performance claims.
assumptions: Replay executes the OPT block-table trace in native 576 KiB units.

provenance.source: docs/HARDWARE-MODELS.md local DRAM preset, capacity overridden for this test
provenance.method: Latency and bandwidth use the local DRAM preset. Capacity is deliberately reduced to 2 GiB so one 8k-context Llama-3-70B KV cache (about 2.54 GiB) cannot fit.
provenance.notes: Test fixture, not a deployment configuration.

provenance.method: Accelerator count and memory capacity from the product class. tokens_per_second intentionally omitted.
CXL.mem class latency and per-port bandwidth; not measured and not fitted to a switch topology.
One-way latency and sustained bandwidth for a CXL.mem class link; queue depth and in-flight limits are scenario assumptions.
